linkedIn.headline: I create world-class experiences for online brands.
linkedIn.about:
Nice to meet you! My name is Austin Evans, and I am a creative designer currently based in Huntsville, AL. I have worked in a variety of design fields, and led teams in the execution and creation of many bespoke client design projects. I love collaborating with other creatives in the pursuit of a larger vision, and the concept-to-reality process of taking an idea and bringing it to life. I am driven, motivated, and excited to start on our next project together!

Portfolio - austin-evans-portfolio.webflow.io

experiences.title: Senior Web Designer
experiences.description:
Worked with marketing team to establish the most common customer journeys through the website, and optimized the flow from landing page all the way through checkout to improve conversion rate

Conducted regular website audits, implemented best practices for User Interface / User Experience, and established platform-native solutions to accomplish business goals without outsourcing functionality to third party apps or services

Designed and implemented new homepages, landing pages, product pages, and website sections that improved the appearance, flow, and usability of the site while maintaining a heavy focus on conversion rate

Implemented advanced e-commerce functionalities across multiple company websites. These included customer reviews, cross-site navigation for all brands under the company umbrella, a higher converting email collection popup, and advanced email segmentation that maximized revenue during the Christmas season.

Worked with corporate accounts department to establish corporate customer funnel pain points, and built new customer journeys on-site that addressed these pain points and made the customer journey easier, resulting in a higher conversion rate

experiences.title: Senior Web Designer
experiences.description:
Worked with clients to establish scope of work and project outlines, then organized and distributed detailed objective plans to the team for the most effcient workload.

Used brand style guides to build beautiful, interactive website experiences that connect with the end user. Ensured these sites were lightweight, fast, and optimized for maximum conversions.

Utilized product and promotional information to build conversion-focused landing pages, as well as complex upsell/downsell sequences to maximize each conversion for the highest Average Order Value possible.

Established roadmaps for customer nurturing through Email and SMS platforms, then used these roadmaps to design Email and SMS creative and copy for multiple segmentation flows and campaigns to take customers from new purchasers to dedicated, raving fans.

experiences.title: Product Designer
experiences.description:
Designed new home decor products for production using AutoCAD, Adobe Illustrator, & Solidworks. Prepared part files to be fully ready for production on CNC fiber laser machines.

Worked with all departments to establish new Standard Operating Procedures for product movement throughout production facility, eliminating confusion and lost products.

Refined automated, custom coded macro system to create customized monogram part files using order data, then implement those files into the product creation process using CNC Fiber Lasers.

Worked as a videographer, using everything from drones to high end cinema cameras to film and edit videos for online brand pages as well as ads for social media.

Created and maintained creative optimization processes with Photoshop, Illustrator, and Solidworks. These processes were used to produce large amounts of creative assets (images, GIFs, video, etc.), as well as allow the production of customized monogram part files with customer names, dates, and address numbers.
